goal: Implement the requested change using test-driven development: a failing test comes first, then the code that makes it pass
rules: A new or updated test must exist and must have failed before the implementation change (red first)
After the implementation, the full test suite passes
No test may be weakened, skipped, or deleted to force a pass
Only source files may change in the implementation step, not test expectations
Keep the change minimal: no refactors beyond what the test requires
